QuestInfo.name: Use a Hologram Skill 10 Times
QuestInfo.0:
Use a Hologram skill 10 times.

To obtain Hologram skills, equip special equipment in the Quanah world.
Hologram skills are passive skills that have a chance to automatically attack enemies.
